cli_parameter.error: MissingParameter: The parameter InstanceId is required
cli_parameter.fix: Add .N suffix: --InstanceId.1 i-bp1xxxxxxxxxxxx; RepeatList params need numbered suffix
cli_parameter.root_cause: Missing required parameter InstanceId (.N suffix needed for RepeatList)

cli_parameter.error: InvalidParameter: The specified parameter DBInstanceId is not valid
cli_parameter.fix: Verify DBInstanceId format via aliyun rds DescribeDBInstances; IDs start with rm-/rr-/pgm-/rdm- etc.
cli_parameter.root_cause: InvalidParameter -- DBInstanceId must follow 'rm-xxxxx' or 'rr-xxxxx' format

cli_parameter.error: InvalidParameterValue: The specified InstanceType is not available in this region
cli_parameter.fix: Run aliyun ecs DescribeInstanceTypes --RegionId to list available types; choose a valid type for the region
cli_parameter.root_cause: InvalidParameterValue -- InstanceType not available in the target region

cli_parameter.error: MissingParam: The parameter BackendServers is missing or invalid
cli_parameter.fix: Wrap BackendServers as JSON string array: --BackendServers '[{"ServerId":"i-xxx","Weight":100}]'
cli_parameter.root_cause: MissingParam -- BackendServers JSON array format is incorrect

cli_parameter.error: ResourceNotFound: The specified VpcId does not exist in this region
cli_parameter.fix: Verify VpcId via aliyun vpc DescribeVpcs --RegionId; check cross-region resource references
cli_parameter.root_cause: ResourceNotFound -- VpcId not found; may be in a different region or already deleted

cli_parameter.error: QuotaExceeded: Maximum number of scheduled key deletions exceeded
cli_parameter.fix: Cancel pending deletions with CancelKeyDeletion, or request quota increase from Alibaba Cloud
cli_parameter.root_cause: QuotaExceeded -- too many KMS keys pending deletion simultaneously

max_iter.fix: Review failing dimensions; increase --max-iter or refine operation parameters

runtime.prevention: Add pre-flight guard: prompt user confirmation before FlushInstance; require --Force flag
runtime.root_cause: Destructive operation flushed all keys without pre-flight confirmation
